description: This is a PHP class file defining the AWS S3 parser, specifically the `S3Parser` class which extends `AbstractParser`. It handles parsing S3 responses, including error detection, result mutation, and stream processing.

classes.name: Aws\S3\Parser\S3Parser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractParser that provides custom parsing logic for AWS S3 responses, including handling special error cases, mutator management, and stream analysis.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with a protocol parser, error parser, API service object, and optional exception class.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to parse an S3 response, including error checks and applying result mutators.

methods.name: parse200Error
methods.description: Checks if a 200 response contains an XML error, parsing for error code and message, and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: shouldBeConsidered200Error
methods.description: Determines if a command response should be checked for a possible error based on operation output traits.

methods.name: isFirstRootElementError
methods.description: Inspects the beginning of an XML response stream to determine if the root element indicates an error.

methods.name: executeS3ResultMutators
methods.description: Applies all registered result mutators to a parsing result.

methods.name: addS3ResultMutator
methods.description: Adds a mutator to the internal list, with warning if a mutator with that name already exists.

methods.name: removeS3ResultMutator
methods.description: Removes a mutator by name, with warning if it does not exist.

methods.name: getS3ResultMutators
methods.description: Returns the current list of registered result mutators.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a specific member from a stream to the protocol parser.
